data: restored CICIoT2023 bounded archive sample; exact split hashes verified
method: Existing Stackelberg IDS training-loop histories from original_assumptions_reference, seeds 42, 43, 44. For each seed, selected the first applied CLASS_REWEIGHTING decision targeting Recon-PingSweep and compared validation metrics immediately before the decision with the following epoch after the same model trained using the updated weights.
interpretation: Stackelberg selected and applied class reweighting in all three seeds. Recon-PingSweep F1 rose in only one of three seeds; the requested consistent recovery objective was not demonstrated. Macro-F1 rose after the next epoch in all three, but these uncontrolled sequential training changes cannot attribute macro-F1 changes to reweighting alone. This is a validation intervention trace, not a test-set or causal estimate. No outcomes were filtered by whether they improved.
